title: Arthur Christmas
desc: When Santa's gawky son Arthur learns that owing to a technical malfunction a little girl's Christmas gift has been misplaced, he sets out on a mission to deliver the present before it is too late.

title: The Grey
desc: John, a wolf hunter, is one of eight survivors in a plane crash. He must fight off a pack of hungry wolves, mortal injuries and the icy elements to get himself and the survivors back to safety.

title: Limitless
desc: Writer Eddie Morra is sure that he has a dismal future after he loses his job and is dumped by his girlfriend. But an untested drug given by his pal improves his acumen. It also leads to huge trouble.

title: Don't Breathe 2
desc: Norman, a visually challenged navy veteran, lives in quiet solace with his foster daughter, Phoenix. However, he is forced to tap into his darker instincts when Phoenix is abducted.

title: Passengers
